title: Desert Wizard's Spell Shop
description: A hooded wizard with green braids stands behind a stone counter in a desert landscape, casting a glowing red spell. Colorful magical horses with flowing manes gallop across sand dunes and through a swirling cosmic portal in the sky, while potion bottles, spell books, and magical splashes surround the scene.
prompt: A mystical wizard with long green braids and white robes stands at a stone counter in a desert canyon, casting a glowing red spell from his hand. Colorful ethereal horses with flowing purple, blue and green manes gallop across sand dunes and leap through a swirling cosmic nebula portal in the sky filled with stars and glowing particles. Potion bottles with magical creatures inside line the shelves, spell books and glowing magical splashes cover the counter, dramatic fantasy scene
